The Shopmonkey API is a REST API (current version v3) that lets auto, tire, and powersports repair shops integrate their Shopmonkey account - Work Orders, Customers, Vehicles, Parts/Inventory, Invoices/Payments, Appointments, Employees (Users), Locations, and Webhooks - with other business systems. Authentication is a Bearer API key generated in the Shopmonkey web app under Settings > Integration > API Keys. Error responses return a JSON body with success, code, message, and documentation_url fields. Rate limiting returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Limit-Minute, and X-RateLimit-Remaining-Minute headers; exact numeric limits are account-specific and not published. Paths and methods below are confirmed against the public Shopmonkey Developer docs at shopmonkey.dev; request/response schemas are modeled (best-effort) from the documented resource fields where full detail was not independently reconciled field-by-field.
